abstract: Human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) was extracted and purified from urine of normal pregnant women and patients with hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma using the sam methods. Both hCG-hydatidiform mole and hCG-choriocarcinoma as well as hCG-normal pregnancy was separated into alpha and beta subunits by SDS disc electrophoresis upon treatment with 2-mercaptoethanol and showed the same immunoreactivities against anti-hCG, -alpha hCG, and -beta hCG as hCG in each radioimmunoassay. In vivo bioassay, bioactivities of hCG- normal pregnancy and hCG-hydatidiform mole were approximately 7,000 IU/mg (2nd IS), while that of hCG--choriocarcinoma was only 400 IU/mg. Conversely, the receptor binding activities in vitro of hCG-chorio carcinoma was about 3 times more effective than the other 2. Although the amino acid composition of these hCG preparations were practically identical, a great difference in the carbohydrate composition was observed. The significant difference was that while sialic acid was undetectable in hCG-choriocarcinoma approximately 8.5% of sialic acid was found in hCG-normal pregnancy and hCG-hydatidiform mole. A parallel finding was that iodinated hCG-choriocarcinoma was taken up in large quantities by the liver in comparison to the ovary which differed from that observed with hCG-normal pregnancy and hCG-hydatidiform mole in Parlow rats. The present findings support the thesis that neoplastic or malignant transformation of trophoblasts may result in an alteration of the glycosylation process, especially the sialylation, in the biosynthesis of hCG rather than the translation steps.
abstract_ja: 正常妊娠、胞状奇胎、絨毛癌の患者の尿から、同一の方法でヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を抽出・精製した。3種のhCG製剤はいずれも、2-メルカプトエタノール処理後のSDSディスク電気泳動によりαおよびβサブユニットに分離され、各ラジオイムノアッセイで抗hCG、抗α-hCG、抗β-hCG に対して同じ免疫反応性を示した。in vivo生物活性は、正常妊娠と胞状奇胎由来hCGが約7,000 IU/mg（第2国際標準）であったのに対し、絨毛癌由来hCGは400 IU/mgにすぎなかった。一方、in vitro受容体結合活性は絨毛癌由来hCGが他の2つより約3倍高かった。3種のhCG製剤のアミノ酸組成はほぼ同一であったが、糖鎖組成には大きな差が認められた。顕著な相違として、絨毛癌由来hCGではシアル酸が検出されなかったが、正常妊娠と胞状奇胎由来hCGには約8.5%のシアル酸が存在した。また、ヨウ素化した絨毛癌由来hCGはParlowラットにおいて卵巣に比べて肝臓に大量に取り込まれ、正常妊娠・胞状奇胎由来hCGとは異なる挙動を示した。本知見は、栄養膜細胞の腫瘍性・悪性転化がhCG生合成の翻訳段階ではなく、糖鎖付加過程、特にシアル酸化の変化をもたらすという説を支持する。
